title: fritillaria pyrenaea
intro: Fritillaria pyrenaea, commonly known as the Pyrenean fritillary, is a species of flowering plant in the lily family. This plant has been traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its ability to act as a expectorant and a demulcent. The therapeutic actions of Fritillaria pyrenaea include its use in treating coughs, colds, and respiratory infections, as well as its application in traditional Chinese medicine for its purported ability to clear heat and detoxify the body. The bioactive constituents of Fritillaria pyrenaea include alkaloids such as veratridine and protoveratrine, as well as saponins and other glycosides that contribute to its medicinal properties.
